pull_requests.title: Exponential backoff for payment gateway timeouts
pull_requests.author: priya.sharma
pull_requests.body:
After the Mar 10 outage (INC-2025-0310) where the payment provider returned intermittent 504s, we saw cascading failures. This PR introduces exponential backoff + jitter.

Related: INC-2025-0310, ADR-007, ISSUE-881

architecture_decisions.title: Retry policy for external payment providers
architecture_decisions.context: After INC-2025-0310 we needed a clear policy for transient failures.
architecture_decisions.decision: Exponential backoff with jitter, max 3 attempts (updated from 5), circuit breaker after consecutive failures. Do not retry 4xx.
architecture_decisions.consequences: Slightly higher latency on transient errors; much better resilience. Monitor retry rate.

architecture_decisions.title: Idempotency for order creation
architecture_decisions.consequences: Clients must send stable keys; eliminates duplicate tickets.

architecture_decisions.title: Optimistic locking for inventory mutations
architecture_decisions.decision: Version column; fail on mismatch; client retries.
architecture_decisions.consequences: Higher conflict rate under extreme contention; acceptable.

architecture_decisions.title: Feature flags required for payment retry experiments
architecture_decisions.context: Past retry changes caused latency and outage amplification.
architecture_decisions.decision: Any change to retry/circuit-breaker defaults ships behind a flag with canary.
architecture_decisions.consequences: Slower rollout; safer rollback (see rb-2025-06-12 pattern).

architecture_decisions.title: Double-entry for billing refunds
architecture_decisions.decision: All refunds use double-entry ledger writes in one transaction.
architecture_decisions.consequences: Slightly more complex code; correct balances.

memory_entries.title: Retries without backoff amplify outages
memory_entries.content: INC-2025-0310: immediate retries against a degrading dependency turn a partial outage into a full one.

memory_entries.title: Max retry attempts must be tuned
memory_entries.content: 5 attempts produced unacceptable p99 (INC-2025-0612). Settled on 3 after histograms + config rollback.

memory_entries.title: Circuit breaker required when dependency goes dark
memory_entries.content: Retries alone caused thundering herd (INC-2025-0730). Breaker protects resources.

memory_entries.title: Retry metrics are a leading indicator
memory_entries.content: Elevated retry rates precede user-visible errors. Alert before SEV-1.

memory_entries.title: Idempotency is mandatory when clients retry
memory_entries.content: Any endpoint clients retry after timeout must be idempotent (INC-2025-0415).

memory_entries.title: Aggressive TTL experiments need client readiness
memory_entries.content: Short tokens without client refresh readiness caused session drops; rolled back (rb-2025-03-05).

memory_entries.title: Feature flags for retry policy changes
memory_entries.content: ADR-018: ship retry/circuit changes behind flags after past latency and outage amplification.

memory_entries.title: Refunds need transactional double-entry
memory_entries.content: Partial refunds desynced ledger until PR-150 / ADR-021.

memory_entries.title: Optimistic locking stops oversell races
memory_entries.content: Version checks fixed concurrent last-item races (INC-2025-0520).

memory_entries.title: Index failures need backfill, not only canary pause
memory_entries.content: Pausing canary (rb-2025-09-02) stopped bleed; backfill fixed root cause.
